metadata.natural_language: STAR-9L66-ZTDY is the referral code shared by independent fan site Star Citizen Referrals and owned by PatchOps.

owner.note: The code belongs to this single RSI account. It earns a recruitment point when a recruit buys a game package and spends at least $40 on the pledge store.

referral_codes.verification_scope: Owner confirmed the code; public RSI form visibly populated it. No registration, payment or credit delivery tested.

faq.question: What does a Star Citizen referral code give me?
faq.answer: The standard new-account referral bonus is 50,000 UEC. Use a valid code when creating your RSI account. Check the current signup page for the reward and package terms.

faq.question: Is this a discount on a game package?
faq.answer: No. A referral code adds the standard credit bonus; it does not reduce the checkout price or include an extra ship. Game access and event offers have their own terms.

faq.question: I already made an account. Can I add the code?
faq.answer: RSI allows a 24-hour grace period if you omitted a code. Sign in, open your account summary from the user icon, and look for the referral field near the bottom. An existing referral cannot be replaced.

faq.question: Who benefits when I use this code?
faq.answer: STAR-9L66-ZTDY belongs to PatchOps. RSI awards the owner a recruitment point when a referred player obtains a game package and meets its qualifying $40 USD pledge requirement.

faq.question: Is this the official Star Citizen website?
faq.answer: This is an independent fan site by PatchOps. Account creation and purchases happen on the official Roberts Space Industries website. We never ask for your RSI password.
